title: fix(app-shell,core): keep error-envelope objects out of toast.error — React #31 page crash
body:
Closes #2579.

## Problem

A failed `api` / `flow` / `server-action` action returning the ObjectStack envelope `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }` crashed the whole console page instead of showing an error toast: the error **object** rode `result.error` into `ActionRunner.handlePostExecution` → `toast.error(object)` → sonner rendered it as a React child → Minified React error #31 inside `flushSync`, uncaught, page down. Reported from Setup → Create User's 400 (server half: objectstack-ai/framework#3031, fixed in objectstack-ai/framework#3033).

## Fix — two layers

1. **Sources** (`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`): new module-level `errorDetail(body, fallback)` flattens an error body to a string — `error` string → `error.message` → `message` → HTTP-status fallback — applied to the three handlers that previously did `(body as any)?.error || …` (apiHandler, flowHandler, serverActionHandler).
2. **Sink** (`packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`): the error-toast sink coerces a non-string `result.error` to its `.message` (or a generic `'Action failed'`) before calling the toast handler, so no future handler bug can take the page down again.

## Testing

- New tests: apiHandler flattens the envelope to the message string; falls back to `HTTP <status>` when the body is unusable; ActionRunner coerces a leaked object at the sink (with-message and without-message cases).
- `vitest run` on the two touched test files: 88/88 pass.
- Pure bug fix — no changeset per AGENTS.md.

Browser-level verification will land with the next `.objectui-sha` pin bump in framework (the console bundle is built at the pinned SHA, so an uncommitted worktree can't be smoke-tested in the dogfood console).
